stimuli.description: Three virtual reality environments: an enclosed courtyard with concrete ground, an enclosed courtyard with grass lawn, and an enclosed courtyard with a row of tall trees. All other visual characteristics were identical.

limitations: Non-crossover controlled experiment, less economically efficient.
Used virtual environments instead of real ones, caution in generalizing results.
Excluded confounding factors like swaying leaves/grass in real life.
Compared only two types of vegetation (grass, trees).
Compared vegetation in a single courtyard setting.
Observed SCL responses for only 9 minutes of VR immersion, suggesting longer periods needed to explore trends.
Single study, needs additional studies for generalizability.
Trees may provide other advantages (e.g., shade) not accounted for in the study.
